description: Fetch the published fix for a check id from securealy.com (GET /checks/<id>.json): the catalogue entry plus the fix text the caller is entitled to. Sends only the check id. If the fix endpoint is not available yet, returns the catalogue entry and the fix page URL to read instead.

id.description: A check id, for example hsts.

name: fetch_fix
title: Fetch the fix for a check
